title: Champions of England.
deck: 104 goals. 60 points. The title belongs to Albion.
body: When league football returned after the First World War, Albion produced an extraordinary season. They won the First Division in 1919/20 with 28 victories, 104 goals and 60 points, at a time when a win was worth two points.

The title was secured with four games still to play. Fred Morris led the goalscoring, while the defensive foundations included Jesse Pennington, Joe Smith and goalkeeper Hubert Pearson. The photograph shows the team with the league trophy and the Charity Shield won later in 1920.
